name: Haneko
source:
A member of a fairy clan, she and her kin sneak into the castle (which is treated as an attack by the defenders) to play pranks on its inhabitants. The Haneko clan is well-known for its mischievous nature but it is not hated by other demons as they keep within acceptable boundaries with their antics.

[Spoiler] Haneko is mischievous and quick to jump to conclusions. After giving Fabio a bodyjob, she proclaims herself to be Fabio's lover in public which gives him no end of frustration. She even twists his declaration that they can't be lovers due to their physical incompatibility by proving she can physically endure his insertion.

In her end, she returns to her clan and further spreads the misconception that Fabio is a pervert who gets sexually excited when having intercourse with fairies... [/Spoiler]
